members.name: contributor-reward
members.description: Closes the contributor flywheel — turns the weekly fork-contributor-leaderboard ranking into a tier-priced rewards plan, writes it into memory/distributions.yml, and hands off to distribute-tokens for the actual on-chain send

members.name: contributor-spotlight
members.description: Weekly recognition post for one fork operator — converts fork-cohort cohort data into a named human moment (POWER fork callout with their work, stars, and skills enabled)

members.name: fleet-state
members.description: Weekly fleet-state digest — synthesises fork-cohort, contributor-spotlight, and fork-release-tracker into one "state of the fleet" narrative

members.name: fork-cohort
members.description: Weekly fork-activation cohort tracker — buckets every fork by recent run activity (COLD / STALE / ACTIVE / POWER) with week-over-week deltas

members.name: fork-contributor-leaderboard
members.description: Weekly ranking of developers contributing to the fork fleet and back upstream

members.name: fork-first-run-alert
members.description: Daily — named alert the day a fork completes its first ever workflow run. Fork-cohort runs weekly; this catches the activation moment.

members.name: fork-release-tracker
members.description: Weekly scan — celebrate when any fork of the parent repo cuts a tagged GitHub release. Silent when no fork releases in the window.

members.name: fork-skill-gap
members.description: Weekly cross-fork skill adoption digest — per-fork table of upstream skills the fork hasn't enabled, top forks by gap size called out, silent on small-gap weeks
